_doc: R1T topper parametric source (Step 27 styling pass). Metres. X rearward, Y driver(+), Z up; origin = centreline at the bed's inside front wall, z = 0 on the bed-rail top. Truck values are measured from Rivian's own orthographic line art by step27/style/rivian_reference.py (scale anchors and cross-checks in step27/style/rivian_reference.json); topper values are design decisions recorded in step27/style/STYLE27.md. Every truck value is TAPE-REQUIRED before fabrication.

_provenance.truck.ground_z: R1T side view, wheelbase-scaled (reproduces published 1834 mm roof to 0.04 %); rear view gives 1344 mm -> band 1344-1366 mm
_provenance.truck.cab_back: R1T side view silhouette under the roof spoiler
_provenance.truck.spoiler_tip: R1T side view (x -0.132) and Upfit p.59 plan view (x -0.127) agree
_provenance.truck.cab_roof_z: R1T side view roof ahead of the antenna fin; max 0.469
_provenance.truck.rail_cap_*: Upfit p.59 plan view line clusters at mid-bed (0.644 inner wall, 0.783, 0.828)
_provenance.truck.rear_axle_x: side-view tailgate face minus published 1381 mm bed length and a 60 mm tailgate shell
_provenance.truck.tailgate_x: R1T side view tailgate outer face
_provenance.truck.rail_flat_end_x / tailgate_top_z: R1T side view: rail top flat to x 1.365, rounding down to the tailgate top 32 mm lower
_provenance.published: overall_length, body_width, wheelbase, track, tire_r, bed_* from the R1T Upfitting Guide pp.28-30
_provenance.shell.*: design decisions against R1T/R1S targets, see STYLE27.md; lean 21 deg = R1T C-pillar 21.8 / R1S D-pillar 20.1; rake 15 deg = R1S liftgate 15.2
_provenance.socket.* / hatch.*: derived from the flat-land and flat-rear-face budgets of the styled shell, checked by checks_step27
